text:
```yaml
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 'latest'
          run_install: true
          cache: true

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: pnpm publish --access public
```
